body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Casio expects to launch its 10.1M digital camera 'EXILIM EX-Z100' in Japan market, which is equipped with a wide 28mm lens, 4x optical zoom and a 2.7-inch 230,000 pixel LCD display.
(Picture: 'EXILIM EX-Z100' model to be presented at CES 2008

Supporting video recording with 840 x 480 resolution and SD Memory card slot, it is expected to be available on March 7th for three models(Silver, Gold and Brown) and on March 14th for two(Blue and Pink). Suggested price is 37,000(KRW).
